quest.title: The Nithrone Cipher
quest.description: Tales have been told of an ancient device that had the ability to decipher Nithron Runes.

node.journal_entry: The librarian, ever eager to prattle on about his collection, suggested that a tome titled, "..of Nithron History," may hold some answers.

node.tag: Seek some more knowledge on the Nithron

task.task_instruction: Find the book "...of Nithrone History" inside the Amethyst Athenium
